rationale: 7 Mile Pit Solar is a project beneath the Circle Power Renewables development platform, not a separate manager-level Amber portfolio company. Amber's launch announcement identifies 7 Mile Pit Solar as one of the joint venture's development projects, Amber's current energy page continues to identify Circle Power Renewables as its U.S. investment, and Michigan DNR currently identifies the 7 Mile Pit lessee as Copper Country Power, LLC. Consolidate the project record into the platform, preserve the project's history and sources, and keep one active Amber ownership period at the platform level.

acquisitionExitCheck.acquisitionSearch: Amber and Circle Power launched Circle Power Renewables on May 27, 2021 as a U.S. renewable development platform whose project pipeline included 7 Mile Pit Solar.
acquisitionExitCheck.exitSearch: No Amber exit from Circle Power Renewables was found. Amber's current 2026 energy investment page continues to describe investing in Circle Power Renewables in the United States.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentProjectStatus: Michigan DNR currently lists 7 Mile Pit as a pilot brightfields site leased by Copper Country Power, LLC. The project remains subordinate to the development-platform census boundary.
